description: Implementation of DistributedSub interface for pub/sub functionality using Akka actors, handling subscriptions, unsubscriptions, acknowledgements, and subscriber management.

classes.name: DistributedSubImpl
classes.description: Final class implementing distributed subscription management with methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, and handling acknowledgements.

methods.name: subscribeWithFilterAndAck
methods.description: Subscribes to topics with a filter and acknowledgment, returning a CompletionStage of SubAck.

methods.name: subscribeWithAck
methods.description: Subscribes to topics with acknowledgment, returning a CompletionStage of SubAck.

methods.name: unsubscribeWithAck
methods.description: Unsubscribes from topics with acknowledgment, returning a CompletionStage of SubAck.

methods.name: askSubSupervisor
methods.description: Sends a request to the subSupervisor actor and processes the response.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the subscription list.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgment labels for a subscriber.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgment label declaration for a subscriber.

methods.name: processAskResponse
methods.description: Processes responses from ask pattern, returning appropriate CompletionStage.
